application.title: Real Estate Project Management
application.description: End-to-end project management for real-estate developers covering masters, project planning, phases, tasks, activities, action point check-lists, daily progress, issues/risks, dashboards, reports and a public marketing website.

navigation.title: Home
navigation.description: Authenticated landing page for all internal users.
navigation.functional_specs: Smart Page welcome/home: greeting, quick links, KPI cards, my action points grid, go-to-project search, create new project CTA, help link.

navigation.title: Master Data
navigation.functional_specs: Group for master data management.

navigation.title: Manage Employee
navigation.description: Maintain employees who can be assigned to project work.
navigation.functional_specs: Search/Add/Edit/Delete employees. Fields: Code, Name, Designation, Department, Email, Mobile, Reporting Manager, DOJ, Status, Remarks. Unique code/email; soft-delete on Inactive; flag open action points on deactivation.

navigation.title: Manage Project Location
navigation.functional_specs: Search/Add/Edit/Delete locations. Fields: Code, Name, Address, City, State, Pin, Country, Lat/Lng, Status. Unique code; pin 6 digits.

navigation.title: Project Setup & Planning
navigation.description: Project, phase, task, activity and action point planning.
navigation.functional_specs: Group for project planning and work breakdown.

navigation.title: Manage Project
navigation.functional_specs: Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete, Submit-for-Approval, Approve, Cancel. Project Location is an optional (non-mandatory) field. Validations on dates, budget tolerance, completion rules. Triggers: send-notification to approver on submit; update-status & stamp approval on approve; cascade-cancel on cancel.

navigation.title: Manage Project Phase
navigation.functional_specs: Phases with sequence, weightage, owner, dates and status. Weightage sum=100; cannot complete with open tasks; cascade-cancel child tasks; recompute project % on completion.

navigation.title: Manage Task
navigation.functional_specs: Tasks with category, priority, dates, predecessor, weightage, % complete. Roll-up to phase/project on update.

navigation.title: Manage Activity
navigation.functional_specs: Activities with type, priority, dates, assignee, derived % complete from action points. Roll-up triggers to task/phase/project.

navigation.title: Manage Action Point
navigation.description: Maintain check-list of action points under an activity.
navigation.functional_specs: Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete, Mark-Done, Mark-Blocked, Cancel. Validations on due date range, completed date, blocking reason. Triggers: notify activity owner on done; notify task owner & PM on blocked; recompute progress roll-up.

navigation.title: Manage Checklist
navigation.functional_specs: Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete, Close. Header fields: Code, Name, Project, Task, Activity, Status, Remarks. Tabular line items: Seq, Description, Responsible Employee, Due Date, Completed Date, Status, Blocking Reason, Remarks. Mandatory Project/Task/Activity linkage; at least one line item; Blocking Reason required when Blocked.

navigation.title: Execution & Monitoring
navigation.functional_specs: Group for execution and monitoring.

navigation.title: Log Daily Progress Update
navigation.functional_specs: Capture progress notes, issues, % update, photographs against task/activity. On save updates progress roll-up; notifies PM on issues.

navigation.title: Manage Project Issue / Risk
navigation.functional_specs: Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete, Close, Cancel. Critical issues protected from delete. Triggers: notify+email PM on critical add; notify reporter on close.

navigation.title: Information Outputs
navigation.functional_specs: Group for BI visuals and reports.

navigation.title: Project Portfolio Grid
navigation.functional_specs: Grid visual with criteria Type/Category/Status/Priority/PM/Date Range/Location; drill-down to Project Workspace.

navigation.title: Phase Progress Pivot
navigation.functional_specs: Pivot rows=Project, cols=Phase Type, values=%complete avg + count of tasks.

navigation.title: Task Status Distribution
navigation.description: Task counts by phase and status.
navigation.functional_specs: Stacked-Column chart: x=Phase, y=count of tasks, stack=Status.

navigation.title: Action Point Aging
navigation.functional_specs: Bar chart by Assigned Employee bucketed 0-7/8-15/16-30/>30 days.

navigation.title: Project Timeline Gantt
navigation.functional_specs: Grid Gantt with Phase/Task/Activity hierarchy, planned vs actual + % complete bars.

navigation.title: Issue & Risk Cards
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual: Open, Critical, Overdue, Mitigated this month.

navigation.title: Budget vs Actual
navigation.description: Budget vs actual spend by phase.
navigation.functional_specs: Column chart x=Phase, series=Approved Budget vs Actual Spend.

navigation.title: Employee Workload
navigation.functional_specs: Pivot rows=Employee, cols=Status, values=count of action points.

navigation.title: Top KPI Cards
navigation.functional_specs: Cards: Active Projects, Avg %, Tasks Due This Week, Overdue Action Points, Open Critical Issues.

navigation.title: Project Status Report
navigation.functional_specs: Jasper pixel-perfect report grouped Project>Phase>Task with sub-totals, header/footer, signature blocks.

navigation.title: Dashboards
navigation.functional_specs: Group for dashboards.

navigation.title: Project Manager Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Composes KPI Cards, Phase Pivot, Task Status, AP Aging, Gantt, Issue Cards filtered to PM's projects.

navigation.title: Executive / Promoter Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Composes KPI cards, Portfolio Grid, Budget vs Actual, Status by Type pie, Projects by Location map.

navigation.title: Site Engineer Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Composes My Action Points, My Activities Progress, My Issues with personal KPI cards.

navigation.title: Workspaces
navigation.functional_specs: Group for smart pages.

navigation.title: Project Workspace
navigation.functional_specs: Hero with project meta, KPI strip, phase navigator + task/activity board with inline action point status toggles, embedded Gantt and AP Aging, recent progress feed, CTAs to add phase/task/progress/issue and open status report.

navigation.title: Help & FAQ
navigation.functional_specs: Hero, intro, accordion FAQs (create project, phase roll-up, mark done, status flow), email support CTA.
